parsed_payload.reasoning: Assume natural numbers are positive integers. Since \(11x+23\) is an integer, \(y=-\frac{x^2}{4}+11x+23\) is an integer exactly when \(\frac{x^2}{4}\) is an integer, i.e. when \(x\) is even. Write \(x=2k\) with \(k\) a positive integer. Then \(y=-\frac{(2k)^2}{4}+11(2k)+23=-k^2+22k+23\). Completing the square gives \(y=-(k-11)^2+144\). For \(y\) to be a positive integer, \(144-(k-11)^2>0\), so \((k-11)^2<144\), hence \(-12<k-11<12\), i.e. \(-1<k<23\). The positive integers satisfying this are \(k=1,2,\ldots,22\). Each gives a distinct \(x=2k\), so the number of points is \(\boxed{22}\).
